- A bullet item that is long enough to need wrapping because it runs well past
  the seventy-nine column limit.
- Short item with a continuation line.
  - A nested bullet item that is also long enough to need wrapping at the
    seventy-nine column limit.

10. An ordered item with a two-digit number that is long enough to need
    wrapping past the limit.

- [ ] A task item that is long enough to need wrapping because it runs well
      past the seventy-nine column limit.
- [x] Done item.

1. First paragraph of a loose item that is long enough to need wrapping past
   the column limit.

   Second paragraph of the same item, also long enough to need wrapping past
   the column limit.

2. Second item.

- Item text before code that is long enough to need wrapping past the
  seventy-nine limit.
  ```sh
  echo "a code line inside a list item that is long enough to pass the seventy-nine limit"
  ```
  Item text after the code block that is also long enough to need wrapping past
  the limit.
